name: robots/ammar-n-abbas__sim2real-ur-gym-gazebo
title: Sim2Real UR5 task-space environment (ROS Gazebo)
intro: Sim2Real UR5 task-space environment (ROS Gazebo), adapted from ammar-n-abbas/sim2real-ur-gym-gazebo. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
